mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 3.0% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as elevated unemployment signals weak labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending.
evidence_refs: fact: UNRATE was 3.5 in the snapshot (2019-09-01 vintage)
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE exceeding 3.0%, or the unemployment rate does not sustain the increase beyond the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both total demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) above their 2019-04-01 vintage levels signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST rise > 5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite both proxies rising above thresholds, or the rise is not sustained beyond the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as higher interest rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 2.5% in a tightening cycle, or the tightening cycle ends before the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the industrial production index below 105 signals weakening supply-side activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as reduced manufacturing output impacts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite INDPRO falling below 105, or the drop is not sustained beyond the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in unemployment (UNRATE) above 3.0% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 1.5 million suggest labor market tension, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite both proxies rising above thresholds, or the rise is not sustained beyond the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in total demand (GDPC1) above its 2019-04-01 vintage value of 19,021.86 signals robust economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite GDPC1 rising above its 2019-04-01 value, or the trend reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, sustained unemployment above 3.5% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as elevated joblessness indicates weakening labor market momentum and reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE exceeding 3.5% in a late-cycle expansion, or the expansion ends before the trigger occurs.
